classes.definition: Information entity with at least one explicit recordOf link to SourceArtifact.
classes.label: Addressable Source Record

classes.definition: An actual mapping assessment execution; its products need not establish identity.
classes.label: Alignment Activity

classes.definition: Information expressing a proposition and its evidential status; typing an assertion never asserts its proposition.
classes.label: Assertion

classes.definition: An Atlas projection record indexed as asset; no equation to the represented real entity.
classes.label: Asset Record

classes.definition: bfo information content explicitly about an Atlas DiseaseConcept.
classes.label: B F O Disease Concept Information

classes.definition: bfo information content explicitly about an Atlas GeneConcept.
classes.label: B F O Gene Concept Information

classes.definition: bfo information content explicitly about an Atlas PhenotypeConcept.
classes.label: B F O Phenotype Concept Information

classes.definition: A concrete genomic sequence-bearing material entity; never an HGNC database page or gene class.
classes.label: Biological Gene

classes.definition: An actual biological specimen; catalog entries are information entities.
classes.label: Biological Sample

classes.definition: A source-qualified proposition about biomedical entities or types; may be disputed or refuted.
classes.label: Biomedical Assertion

classes.definition: A concrete chemical material; drug designation and chemical class records are separate.
classes.label: Chemical Substance

classes.definition: Information grouping contacts and resources; not a material or social community.
classes.label: Community Unit

classes.definition: A reified conceptual description; not the class extension or an instance of that class.
classes.label: Concept

classes.definition: dul information content explicitly about an Atlas DiseaseConcept.
classes.label: D U L Disease Concept Information

classes.definition: dul information content explicitly about an Atlas GeneConcept.
classes.label: D U L Gene Concept Information

classes.definition: dul information content explicitly about an Atlas PhenotypeConcept.
classes.label: D U L Phenotype Concept Information

classes.definition: A reified disease concept used for indexing; MONDO class IRIs remain classes in their original ontologies.
classes.label: Disease Concept

classes.definition: Information entity with at least one explicit isAbout link to DiseaseConcept.
classes.label: Disease Description

classes.definition: An actual pathological process in a bearer, not a MONDO disease class, disposition, diagnostic label, or record.
classes.label: Disease Process

classes.definition: An Atlas projection record indexed as disease; no equation to the represented real entity.
classes.label: Disease Record

classes.definition: An Atlas evidence-bearing edge/reifier including observed, extracted, inferred, hypothesis and withheld projections.
classes.label: Edge

classes.definition: An entity in the Atlas application universe; no automatic equation to a foundation top class.
classes.label: Entity

classes.definition: A reified concept of a gene type; not a gene molecule.
classes.label: Gene Concept

classes.definition: Information entity with at least one explicit isAbout link to GeneConcept.
classes.label: Gene Description

classes.definition: A GenCC submitter-scoped gene disease inheritance validity classification; refutation remains explicit.
classes.label: Gene Disease Validity Assertion

classes.definition: An Atlas projection record indexed as gene; no equation to the represented real entity.
classes.label: Gene Record

classes.definition: Grant award agreement content, distinct from a payment or research activity.
classes.label: Grant Agreement

classes.definition: An Atlas projection record indexed as grant; no equation to the represented real entity.
classes.label: Grant Record

classes.definition: A living human material person, not an author identity record.
classes.label: Human Person

classes.definition: An identifier information item. An identifier denotes a referent and never becomes it through lexical equality.
classes.label: Identifier

classes.definition: An actual rule execution with explicit premise and rule witnesses.
classes.label: Inference Activity

classes.definition: Repeatable information content, distinct from its physical storage, biological referent, and identifier string.
classes.label: Information Entity

classes.definition: An actual data ingestion/reconstruction execution with source dependencies.
classes.label: Ingestion Activity

classes.definition: Semantic unit collecting evidence about one indexed subject.
classes.label: Item Unit

classes.definition: Legacy server export connection record; semantic endpoints must be verified separately.
classes.label: Link

classes.definition: An identifier or terminology correspondence claim with mapping evidence, not automatic individual identity.
classes.label: Mapping

classes.definition: A concrete material bearer. Gene/protein records and organism model catalog entries are not automatically instances.
classes.label: Material Entity

classes.definition: A group of mechanism-related information; not proof of a shared mechanism.
classes.label: Mechanism Item Group Unit

classes.definition: A description of a strain, line, genotype or model; not its material realization.
classes.label: Model Description

classes.definition: A hypothesis or retrieval lead for navigation, not evidence that a clinical or molecular relationship holds.
classes.label: Navigation Lead

classes.definition: A local Atlas release projection entry; its nodeKind is an indexing category of represented content, not its biomedical ontological type.
classes.label: Node

classes.definition: An Atlas projection record indexed as organisation; no equation to the represented real entity.
classes.label: Organisation Record

classes.definition: An actual organism used as a research model, distinct from a strain designation or catalog record.
classes.label: Organism Model

classes.definition: An institutional social agent; not automatically equal to the aggregate of all its current members.
classes.label: Organization

classes.definition: The material aggregate of participants constituting an organization in a given context; separate from its institutional identity.
classes.label: Organization Collective

classes.definition: Content of a scholarly article, distinct from its bibliographic record and physical copy.
classes.label: Paper Content

classes.definition: An Atlas projection record indexed as paper; no equation to the represented real entity.
classes.label: Paper Record

classes.definition: A reified description of a pathway process type; not a pathway execution.
classes.label: Pathway Concept

classes.definition: An Atlas projection record indexed as pathway; no equation to the represented real entity.
classes.label: Pathway Record

classes.definition: An Atlas projection record indexed as person; no equation to the represented real entity.
classes.label: Person Record

classes.definition: A reified phenotype concept, distinct from a quality instance.
classes.label: Phenotype Concept

classes.definition: Information entity with at least one explicit isAbout link to PhenotypeConcept.
classes.label: Phenotype Description

classes.definition: An Atlas projection record indexed as phenotype; no equation to the represented real entity.
classes.label: Phenotype Record

classes.definition: An actual phenotype quality in a bearer, not an HPO class or source frequency annotation.
classes.label: Phenotypic Quality

classes.definition: An actual occurrence unfolding in time, distinct from a protocol, process type, or database record.
classes.label: Process

classes.definition: A concrete protein molecular entity, distinct from its coding gene and database entry.
classes.label: Protein Molecule

classes.definition: An extracted HOOM source association, preserving disease/phenotype/frequency/diagnostic-role class references; not a diagnosis.
classes.label: Qualified Disease Phenotype Assertion

classes.definition: An actual specifically borne characteristic, distinct from a phenotype class or annotation.
classes.label: Quality

classes.definition: A context dependent role borne and realized by a research participant or resource.
classes.label: Research Role

classes.definition: A context dependent realizable role of a bearer; not the bearer or a role vocabulary term.
classes.label: Role

classes.definition: A versioned grouping or statement information unit with provenance.
classes.label: Semantic Unit

classes.definition: A social organization or agreement viewed institutionally; BFO material collectives require an explicit separate facet.
classes.label: Social Entity

classes.definition: Information content of a versioned upstream file or dataset; checksum describes a concrete encoding.
classes.label: Source Artifact

classes.definition: Information content of an addressable record in a source artifact.
classes.label: Source Record

classes.definition: Semantic unit expressing a proposition; hypothesis status does not assert that proposition.
classes.label: Statement Unit

classes.definition: An actual execution of research, distinct from registration, protocol and planned study.
classes.label: Study Execution

classes.definition: Research study plan or protocol information, distinct from its execution.
classes.label: Study Protocol

classes.definition: An Atlas projection record indexed as study; no equation to the represented real entity.
classes.label: Study Record

classes.definition: Information linking semantic units.
classes.label: Unit Link

limitations: No full historical ABox consistency certificate.
OWL RL fixtures and SHACL are additional constraints, not substitutes for HermiT.
BFO Common Logic and ISO DOLCE FOL are outside this OWL profile.
Profiles are independently selectable; combined consistency is an additional compatibility check, not equivalence of foundations.
